assets.title: John Moulton Barn reconstruction
assets.author: Grand Teton project
assets.source: terrain/pipeline/work/hero/john-moulton-barn/placed/place.json (image-to-3D mesh terrain/pipeline/data/hero/meshes/john-moulton-barn.glb, footprint-fit, no LiDAR stage per terrain/pipeline/buildings/hero/place_mesh.py); footprint named 'John Moulton Barn' in terrain/public/buildings.json, built by terrain/pipeline/buildings/build_buildings.py from OSM way 306529655 in terrain/pipeline/data/osm/buildings.osm.json (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0); historic reference only (not redistributed) from Library of Congress HABS records wy0575 (WY-152-C, barn), wy0573 (WY-152-A, house) and wy0339 (WY-152, homestead site), per terrain/pipeline/buildings/hero_candidates/john_moulton/acquired-sources.json
assets.attribution: Project reconstruction: an image-to-3D mesh (no LiDAR) footprint-fitted to an OpenStreetMap-derived placement footprint, with AI-generated wall/roof imagery baked in via terrain/pipeline/buildings/hero/apply_textures.py; dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. Library of Congress HABS records WY-152-C (barn; measured drawings by Barrett Powley, photographs by Arnold Thallheimer; https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/wy0575/), WY-152-A (house; measured drawings by Jeff Farnum, photographs by Arnold Thallheimer; https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/wy0573/) and WY-152 (homestead site; https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/wy0339/) were consulted as documentary reference only — not redistributed here and not a measured input to this mesh's geometry. Per the Library of Congress rights statement: 'No known restrictions on images made by the U.S. Government; images copied from other sources may be restricted.' OpenStreetMap/ODbL attribution for the underlying footprint is carried by the in-app #credit HUD.
assets.recipe: terrain/pipeline/buildings/hero/import_mesh.py + place_mesh.py --fit footprint + apply_textures.py, run against terrain/pipeline/work/hero/john-moulton-barn/ (parameters recorded in placed/place.json: ridgeM 8.062, textureBytes 1078255); footprint sourced by terrain/pipeline/buildings/build_buildings.py from terrain/pipeline/data/osm/buildings.osm.json way 306529655

assets.title: Vegetation photo-billboard atlas
assets.author: Grand Teton project
assets.attribution: Runtime-baked atlas composited from five CC0 tree photo cutouts: the OpenGameArt conifer/spruce-fir sheet by rubberduck (opengameart.org/content/high-res-tree-textures, tree_collection_2K.png), and four cgbookcase.com textures by Dorian Zgraggen (Tree01, Tree04, Tree05, Tree07). All five source cutouts are CC0 1.0 and carry no attribution obligation; the upstream authors are credited here per the project's own record-keeping convention. The bake itself is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
assets.recipe: terrain/src/ScatterManager.js ('?bakeatlas=1' runtime bake path) composites the source cutouts (terrain/public/atlas-candidates/, not shipped in git) into the 8-column 256x512-cell atlas per the source-to-cell mapping and alpha-scan x-ranges documented in terrain/pipeline/VEG-ATLAS-SOURCES.md.
